more_info.overview: Pullulan is used as a thickener in food. Its technological role is to increase the thickness of food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets, food supplements supplied in a solid form excluding food supplements for infants and  young children’,. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Produced by fermenting food-grade hydrolysed starch with a non-toxin-producing Aureobasidium pullulans strain. The fungal cells, pigments and other impurities are removed from the polymer preparation.
